notes.title: Valentine's Day Update & 2 Year Anniversary Sale!
notes.content:
Can you believe it's been two years since [i]Max Gentlemen Sexy Business![/i] launched? 
(Well, technically it launched on the 25th but I'm going to cheat a little, if you'll forgive me.)

To celebrate this, the last [i]planned[/i] update, [i]Max Gentlemen Sexy Business![/i] is [b]69% off[/b]! That's the [u]largest[/u] discount we're likely to ever have!

We've added two new costume sets. A [b]Valentine's[/b] set and a [b]buff[/b] set to match the beard set we added in November. To unlock the buff costumes, just raise any executive's fisticuffs over 100. ːarmpumpː

Oh, and in case you needed an excuse to spend more time with your favorite executives, we've added 25 new friendships for Angel and Cashious with the rest of the cast! They become available near the end of the 3rd arc. (And should be available right away if you've reached that point.)

So maybe you noticed that I called this the [i]last planned update[/i]. What does that mean? Well, officially, [i]Sexy Business[/i] is no longer my first priority. It's time I moved on to a new project. It's been an amazing four years since I started [i]Sexy Business[/i] and I'm so happy to have been able to add the expansion and all these free updates. The community is really amazing and I'm sad to leave this project behind. Is this the end for Max Gentlemen? Probably not. I still have a few ideas for [i]Sexy Business[/i], but I have no idea when and if I will get to them. So for now, I hope what we made is good enough.

If you'd like to follow me, the developer, the best place to do that is twitter. [url=https://twitter.com/HatsProductions]@hatsproductions[/url]

If you'd like to squeeze as much blood out of the stone that is [i]Max Gentlemen Sexy Business![/i] I recommend dropping into the Discord to discuss the finer points of your favorite characters, outfits and dates. [url=https://discord.gg/Baj5dp2]https://discord.gg/Baj5dp2[/url]

Cheers!

notes.title: Free EXPANSION October 12th
notes.content:
Good day!

The huge [i]The British are COMING![/i] update is coming to you October 12th, [i]free of charge[/i]. Not only that, but the [strike]update[/strike] is now an EXPANSION!

What does that mean? Well, not terribly much. Just that the amount of content we've been working on for the past year is so significant, we decided that calling it an expansion was more appropriate.

Expect to see extensive patch notes next week. But stick around if you want a little peek behind the curtain of development.

You might also be asking yourself, why is this expansion [b]free[/b]? You'd be right to ask that. This expansion is [i]easily[/i] a $10 DLC. Honestly, it's equal parts guilt and strategy.

We were aiming to finish this update... about a year ago. Pandemics are a hell of a thing - And with that extra time, came a lot of feature creep. So while, yes, you've all had to wait, there is much much more meat to the [strike]update[/strike] expansion than originally planned. So being late makes me feel bad about charging for it. And yes, 100% of our fans have said they would gladly pay for more content... but that leads into my other reason for making this expansion free.

Sales have been good but not strong enough for me to nickle-and-dime our existing fans. I'd rather foster goodwill, and hope that you all will want to help spread the word about the game, to reach new fans. Plus, with my experience in DLC on Organ Trail, I find that it can fracture the audience. I'm not against expansions or anything, it just doesn't really align with the vision I've had for Max Gentlemen Sexy Business! As a solo dev, it's easier for me to think of MGSB as a single product that is the best it can be for all players, new and old.

If you'd like to help, [u]leaving a positive steam review[/u] is a GREAT way to support us. Really, it helps more than you'd think.

If you're still excited and want to find some like-minded gentlepeople, I recommend dropping by our Discord! https://discord.gg/Baj5dp2

Anyhow. I hope you will all enjoy what we've made for you. See you next week.
Cheers! ːstachemonocleː

notes.title: Still Chugging Along
notes.content:
Just wanted to let everyone know that development on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/817840?emclan=103582791465983273&emgid=2387418644272233777]The British are Coming![/url] update has been very [i]very[/i] slow, but it's still coming.  I dare not venture to announce a new "release date" until we begin testing (aka all the new content is done already). While I still have no idea how long it will take to finish the update at the quality it deserves, know that I'm not working on anything else until we finish this update.

I hate that it's taking much longer than planned but unfortunately my spite alone is not enough to power the studio through the challenges of a pandemic. The added stress of wildly missing our deadline has not been good for me but pretty much all of our fans have been supportive and understanding - so I thank you for that, sincerely.

Anyways, just checking in to let you all know what's up. Thanks for bearing with us!

notes.title: Free Update Delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone. It's now December and the "Fall" release window that I was aiming for for the Free [i]The British are COMING![/i] update is almost past us.

As you can imagine, the pandemic has impacted everyone on the team and our schedule was nothing more than wishful thinking during this bollocks of a year. Rest assured, this update is all I've been working on. We've even brought on 5 new team members since launch! On the plus side, the extra time means we've been able to add[i] even more [/i]content than we originally planned. So where does the update stand? Well, I'm currently aiming for "Winter(?)" now.

I apologize for the delay and it's heartbreaking to have to wait so long to share our work with you. I must ask you to wait a bit longer but I can promise it will be worth it (free!?) We could easily charge $10 for the amount of content we're adding -or- have rushed it out the door to meet the initial deadline but... well, nah I'd rather do a good job and reward our fan-base with the [b]luscious [/b]update you all deserve.

Speaking of, Here is a peek at [i]just some[/i] of features to expect in the update:

[*] New asset upgrades system
